filter_bias_and_norm: filter JAX model parameters to exclude bias and normalization scale weights from optimization
filter_cls_and_posembed: filter JAX model parameters to exclude cls token and positional embedding weights
filter_posembed: filter JAX model parameters to exclude positional embedding weights from the parameter tree
filter_freeze_keys: filter JAX model parameters to freeze specified keys like a CLIP image feature extractor
filter_parameters: apply a custom filter function to a JAX parameter tree using nested map structure
